content: BullMQ: a job whose processor runs longer than lockDuration without the lock being renewed is marked 'stalled' by the periodic stalled-checker (runs every stalledInterval, default 30000ms) and is automatically re-queued to another worker -- this IS a double-processing event if the original processor is still running (e.g. hung on a network call). maxStalledCount (default 1) bounds how many times a job can be recovered from stalled before moving to failed.
